description: Project the four selected telemetry fields from a local JSON array of objects, retaining each scalar's text representation.

interface.semantic_input: Local JSON array of objects with the exact selector for sensor, room, minute and temp. Each selected field must occur once and hold a string, number or boolean.
interface.semantic_output: Ordered rows of four scalar texts, with one-based array positions.

implementation_form: authored C++ adapter over vendored yyjson in retained DuckDB reader library
resources: The parser loads the input before visitation. Qualification uses small fixtures. Peak memory, maximum input size and throughput are unmeasured.

preconditions.detail: Use a readable JSON array and the exact telemetry selector. Each selected key must be unique in its object and select a supported scalar.

postconditions.detail: The reader delivered selected texts in selector order, including original numeric token spelling, decoded string contents, and boolean texts. Duplicate input objects retained separate positions.

refinements.detail: Reordering selector fields reordered the result. Unselected nested and repeated fields were ignored in a successful fixture. Repeated selected keys were detected after key decoding.

effects.detail: No fixture bytes changed. A late shape error followed an already delivered row in the direct visitor. The ordinary H035 composition preserved destination state on the tested input errors.

invariants.detail: Successful repeat visits to the same stable fixture produced identical records and started positions at one.

mathematical_properties.detail: No proof over arbitrary JSON inputs was established.

formal_predicates.detail: The detached exact argument predicate bounds the reviewed fixture evidence. Whole-input validity has no formal proof here.

state_protocol.detail: Empty or non-string selectors failed during producer creation. A malformed input produced no callbacks. A late invalid record stopped after the successfully visited prefix.

ownership.detail: The producer captures the path and selector names by value. The visitor borrows a row for the duration of the callback.

concurrency.detail: Concurrent visits and input changes during visitation were untested.

upstream_usage.detail: The adapter calls yyjson_read_file with raw-number parsing. H035 consumes integer minute and temperature fields for room/day ranges.

specification_question.detail: Which fields are required, and should the text form of numeric values be preserved? This evidence covers the sensor, room, minute and temp projection.
